div.div: وِطَآءٌ (S, K) and ↓ وَطَآءٌ , (K,) the former is the word commonly known and approved; the latter disapproved by many; (TA;) The contr. of غِطَآءٌ (a covering); [what is placed, or spread, beneath one, to sit or lie upon]: (S, K:) pl. اوْطِئَةٌ. (TA, in art. خور.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
